card.name: Words just before depression or mental illness terms
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation in passages about depression or mood disorders, right where a depression or mental-illness term is likely to come next. Examples are 'also referred to as', 'or', 'manic', 'both' and an opening parenthesis.
